notes: «المعروف بالكرماني» is an epithet, not part of the name, and is left out
Sa'd narrates his own account; Imam Abu Muhammad (al-Hadi) speaks inside it, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
The boy in the story (الغلام) and Ahmad b. Ishaq are present in the scene and not links; the ghulam's speech is not a transmission
